verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an identity-verification SaaS, but the evidence shows no natural-language command interface. The closest items are a no-code drag-and-drop Workflow Builder and an llms.txt documentation file. Visual builders and LLM-readable docs are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the product itself accepting natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
